title: Santoro commits his future to the Lions
text: Captain Aurelio Santoro has signed a new contract that keeps him at Aurelia Park until 2030. "This club is my home," said the number 10.

title: Three goals at Castelvar keep us top
text: Lennart Vos scored twice and Jules Lambrecht added a late third as the Lions won 3–1 away to stay one point clear at the top of the table.

title: Cup quarter-final tickets on general sale
